about_the_game:
Farmtastic is a fun and colorful farming simulation game with charming cartoon-style graphics. Build your farm from the ground up and spend hours exploring a vibrant world full of farming, livestock, construction, and quest systems.

🧑‍🌾 Key Features
🌾 Farming: Plant seeds, water your fields, and harvest a variety of crops!
🐄 Animal Care: Raise cows, chickens, sheep, and more. Collect resources like milk and eggs.
🏠 Building System: Design your farm your way. Place barns, storage buildings, roads, and more.
🧭 Quest System: Help local villagers, unlock new items, and discover new areas.
🎨 Colorful World: Enjoy a relaxing atmosphere filled with cute characters and peaceful environments.

🎯 Gameplay
Farmtastic features an open-ended structure where you can take it slow and enjoy tending your land, or focus on completing quests and expanding your homestead. Progression systems include character growth, building upgrades, and resource management.

⏱ Estimated Playtime
Between 5 to 15 hours depending on your playstyle. Farmtastic is ideal for both short, relaxing sessions and longer playthroughs.

short_description: Step into a colorful world! In this fun farm game with cartoon-style graphics, plant and harvest fields, take care of animals, build structures, and complete villagers' tasks to write your own farm story and pay off your debt. Wander around the fun world or build a giant barn - it's your choice!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Turkish, French
